bio: Research Overview Publications Contact Us Pamela recently graduated with her Ph.D. from the University of Nevada, Reno in Cellular and Molecular Pharmacology and Physiology. She specialized in congenital muscular dystrophies related to extracellular matrix proteins and potential pharmaceutical interventions. She is starting her first year as a post-doctoral researcher working on the SELENON protein and MAST2 projects. Phenotypic Spectrum of DNM2-Related Centronuclear Myopathy. Neurol Genet. 2022 Dec; 8(6):e200027. View Abstract A data-driven architecture using natural language processing to improve phenotyping efficiency and accelerate genetic diagnoses of rare disorders. HGG Adv. 2021 Jul; 2(3). View Abstract
